Package org.frc5411.lib.utility

Class Figures

java.lang.Object
org.frc5411.lib.utility.Figures
public class Figures extends Object

Figures

Utility class for anything relating to numbers, houses a handful of static methods which perform simple, but nonetheless repetitive calculations.
